node: Data-center power delivery, grid interconnection, transformers, switchgear, and thermal infrastructure
summary: Layer 1B expansion found a clear two-lane mapping. Reference lane: Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova and Quanta remain the obvious AI data-center power/cooling/grid anchors, but most are already high-attention and large/mega-cap. Underfollowed discovery lane: Powell Industries, MYR Group and Atkore sit closer to narrower chokepoints: medium-voltage switchgear and packaged power rooms; specialty electrical construction, transmission/distribution, substations and data-center build-outs; and electrical raceway/conduit/cable-management products used in commercial, industrial, data-center and utility applications. The strongest factual signals in this pass are Powell's over-$400M behind-the-meter data-center order and MYR's stated data-center and grid electrical construction exposure. Atkore is included as a component-level hypothesis because its company materials explicitly identify data centers as an end market, but more work is needed to quantify AI/data-center revenue mix and whether price/cycle headwinds offset unit demand.
